source.title: Peptide-Based Scaffolds Support Human Cortical Progenitor Graft Integration to Reduce Atrophy and Promote Functional Repair in a Model of Stroke

material: Fmoc-DDIKVAV self-assembling peptide hydrogel alone (SAP-only implant)

formulation.evidence: Final concentration of implanted SAP gels was 10 mg/mL and total number of cells 100,000/rat.

other_outcomes.evidence: SAP implants alone minimally protected against atro­phy of the host tissue (28.3 ± 2.6%; Figures 7A and 7G)
other_outcomes.name: cortical atrophy (SAP only)

other_outcomes.evidence: SAP implants, in the absence of cells, provided no significant benefit for forelimb function, (26.0 + 3.1%
other_outcomes.name: staircase impaired paw pellet retrieval

notes: Scaffold-only implants into ET1 ischemic lesion of athymic nude rats.
